name: Armchair, Designwerk Passion 100

clearance.note: Legroom in front of the seat; a coffee table can stand 45 cm away

notes: Designwerk Passion armchair, the single-seat module: "Armchair incl. 1 MBA", item D140100B (not the rotatable D140105B). Sizes from Designwerk's Passion leaflet (designwerk.li, produktflyer-passion-05-2026-en.pdf, page 4, the type plan): 100 wide, 118 deep, 83 high, seat height 43, seat depth 76/59. Armless, so modules stand side by side; this is the module on its own. Shown with the back pushed back (seat depth 76), as on the type plan: the manual back adjustment (MBA) pulls it forward to a seat depth of 59, and the planner shows this one position. Designwerk's feet are plastic, 25 mm high and almost invisible (page 3). model.glb is generated by `npx tsx tools/models/designwerk-passion.ts` from its own geometry after the type plan and Designwerk's photos: a plump base narrowing to the floor with its fabric gathered, a seat cushion stitched round its edge and split by seams into two sections, and a tall back leaning back, its sections matching the seat's, each a pillow over a lumbar roll. The default grey linen is close to the leaflet's cover fabric (Shine W015 Argento); Designwerk makes Passion in fabric and leather (one colour), and the colours here are planning colours, not Designwerk's. The seat is a surface, so cushions and throws can go on it.
